infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bored in Line uses your camera to take a check-in photo at a bar. For example, when you tap into a venue, you can snap a photo of the crowd or atmosphere to share with friends in the bar's live feed.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bored in Line uses your photo library to share photos in posts and check-ins. For example, you can choose an existing photo from your library to post in the bar feed so friends can see what's happening at the venue.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Bored in Line saves photos to your library when you capture them in the app, such as photos taken during a bar check-in.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Bored in Line uses your location to show nearby bars and verify you are physically at a venue when you check in. For example, your location is used to confirm you are within half a mile of a bar before allowing check-in.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Bored in Line uses your location to show nearby bars and verify you are physically at a venue when you check in. For example, your location is used to confirm you are within half a mile of a bar before allowing check-in.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bored in Line uses your microphone to record audio when you capture a video to share in the bar feed. For example, when you record a short video clip at a bar to post for your friends, the microphone captures the sound of the venue.
